description.zh: 该预警类型下的用户预警规则列表，不传代表没有预警阈值
description.en: A list of alert rules for the specified alert type. If you do not specify this parameter, no alert threshold is set.

description.zh: 预警类型：quota_low_balance（代表Quota低额预警）
description.en: The alert type. The value quota\_low\_balance indicates a low-balance alert for a quota.

descriptions.zh: 设置Quota额度低额预警规则。
